description: Scrape the public TikTok Ad Library transparency database.

adIds.description: Direct list of TikTok ad IDs. Bypasses search and fetches each ad's detail page directly.
adIds.title: Ad IDs (direct lookup)

ctaFilter.description: Only emit ads whose call-to-action button text contains one of these substrings (case-insensitive — e.g. `Shop Now`, `Learn More`, `Sign Up`). Ads without a CTA are dropped. Requires `quickSearch=false` — CTA data is only available from the detail page.
ctaFilter.title: CTA filter (Pro)

endDate.description: Latest ad end date. Default: today.
endDate.title: End date (YYYY-MM-DD)

industryFilter.description: Only emit ads whose advertiser industry contains one of these substrings.
industryFilter.title: Industry filter (Pro)

languageFilter.description: Only emit ads in these languages (matched case-insensitively against the `adLanguages` field, e.g. `en`, `de`, `fr`). Ads without a detected language are kept. Most effective with `quickSearch=false`.
languageFilter.title: Language filter (Pro)

minImpressions.description: Drop ads with fewer than this many impressions (numeric value parsed from TikTok's bucket like `10K-100K`).
minImpressions.title: Min impressions (Pro)

query.description: Free-text query — company name, domain, or ad text. Leave empty to browse all recent ads.
query.title: Search query

quickSearch.description: When true, skip the ad-detail fetch and only return data from the listing card. Faster but omits some fields (full targeting breakdown).
quickSearch.title: Quick search (skip detail pages)

region.description: TikTok ad region. The library covers EU/EEA + UK/CH/TR (DSA transparency). Use `all` for all-region search.
region.title: Region

regionFilter.description: Only emit ads that target one of these regions. Case-insensitive substring match against `targetingByLocation`.
regionFilter.title: Region filter (Pro)

requestDelaySecs.description: Pause between successive API calls. Lower = faster runs but more rate-limit risk; higher = slower but more reliable. The actor still adds short backoff between retries automatically.
requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between requests (seconds)

startDate.description: Earliest ad start date. Default: 1 year ago.
startDate.title: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)

timezone.description: IANA timezone for date-range bucketing (`startDate`/`endDate`). Default UTC.
timezone.title: Timezone

useApifyProxy.description: Route requests through Apify's proxy pool (datacenter EU exit IPs). Recommended on cloud — avoids IP rate-limiting. The actor automatically rotates the proxy session on errors.
useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify proxy

title: TikTok Ads Library Scraper Pro Input
